lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of vertical columns containing 3 to 5 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a rectilinear grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular spot centroids, forming a regular grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient, with higher intensity on the dorsal edge and a shadow transition on the ventral edge.
